messages:
Rowan: Heads-upopened a compact PR that replaces duplicated 429/timeouts examples with a tiny decision checklist + two SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9001. Need review for accuracy and ops caveats.
Tess: Nice. Which SDKs included?
Rowan: JS (retry + Retry-After) and Python (context-trim helper). Also a one-line curl example for non-idempotent guidance.
Ibrahim: runtime: call out that Retry-After can be fractional seconds in some proxies; parse defensively. Also recommend exponential backoff cap (e.g., 10s).
Nina: docs nit: use three backticks + language tag on all codeblocks, add header names (Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining).
Rowan: updated codeblocks and added header list. Added note about idempotency: don't auto-retry non-idempotent chat sends without server dedupe.
Tess: Suggest adding tiny flow: primary model -> small-context fallback -> quantized model -> regional fallback -> error-mode (429 degrade). One-liner each.
Rowan: added one-liner flow and a short warning about prefix-cache TTL changes causing unexpected cached context in chat apps.
Ibrahim: LGTM for runtime semantics after fractional Retry-After note and backoff cap.
Nina: DocsBot: PR 9001 pushed with edits; CI: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/9001/checks. Please remember changelog entry.
Rowan: thanks everyone. Merging EOD if no blockers. :rocket:
